Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be carried out
every six months as 
indicated by M6 in the above title block. This pump is used to pumped 
feed water from feed water tank to high pressure heater.
The first draft initiated 
and tested by eng.

accepted by eng.

This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be 
 sure pump must be completely drainage.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Vibrometer, dial indicator.
Cleaning fluid.
Work to be Carried Out
Before Pump Shut Down
Check discharge quantity and pressure and compare them with the setting value.
Measure vibration level for bearings and compare it with the setting value, 
 then analyze it and determine what to do ( if it is needed ).
Pump Shut Down
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value.
Check the bolts fixation, then retightens ( if it is needed ).
Check the level and validity of bearing oil and add or change (if it is 
 needed).
Check the mechanical seal for leaking.
Check flanges for leaking.
Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint (if it is needed).
